newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Salomon offers to underwrite bond offer for Manila.
newsitem.headline: Salomon offers to underwrite bond offer for Manila.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Sunday it has received an offer from Salomon Brothers to lead manage a Yankee bond issue for an amount of up to $1 billion and a maturity of up to 30 years.

In a statement, the bank said the offer was made by Salomon Brothers chairman Robert Denham when he came to Manila last week to attend meetings related to the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit which the Philippines hosted.
The Central Bank earlier received an offer from Morgan Stanley for a similar issue, it said, adding that Merrill Lynch had also indicated its intention to underwrite a similar bond issue.
Central Bank Governor Gabriel Singson said he expected to receive soon at least two more offers from different banks which had already informally indicated their interest.

"The main reason for considering a Central Bank bond issue is primarily to establish a 30-year benchmark which will facilitate the competitive pricing of subsequent government and private sector bond issues that can be used for financing major capital projects," the statement said.
The Central Bank has set up a task force to evaluate the merits of the different proposals. -- Manila newsroom.
